name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly and easily find nearby recycling facilities based on their location or specific search criteria.
The User seeks to view detailed information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and other relevant community initiatives.
The User wants to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, tracking their recycling activities, and receiving tailored recommendations.
The User aims to easily submit feedback, ask questions, and report issues to improve the overall recycling service.
The User wants to schedule flexible pickup times, select different types of recyclable waste, and receive recommendations for recycling centers that best fit their weekly schedule and waste types.
The Administrator aims to ensure that all recycling facility information displayed on the platform is current, correct, and comprehensive.
The Administrator seeks to efficiently review, categorize, and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to enhance user satisfaction.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain clear communication channels with facility representatives to coordinate updates and address issues.
The Facility Representative aims to easily and accurately update their facility's operational hours, accepted materials, and other relevant details.
The Facility Representative seeks a direct and effective way to convey any operational issues or concerns to the site administrators for resolution.
The Superuser aims to provide the most current and accurate information about recycling centers to users by having elevated update privileges.
The Superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, leveraging their elevated access to information.
lowLevelGoals: The User can initiate a search for recycling facilities using their current GPS coordinates.
The User can apply filters to display only recycling facilities that accept specific material types (e.g., plastic, paper, glass).
The User can see a list of recycling facilities ordered by proximity to their current location or search area.
The User can view recycling centers, public bins, and special waste drop-off sites visually on an interactive map.
The User can click on a facility's address to open a third-party navigation application (e.g., Google Maps) with the facility's location pre-filled.
The User can apply filters to display only recycling facilities that meet specific environment-friendly criteria.
The User can select a facility from a list or map to view its detailed information.
The User can see the opening and closing times for a selected recycling facility.
The User can see a list of all materials accepted by a selected recycling facility.
The User can opt-in to receive email alerts about upcoming recycling events.
The User can register for a new account on the platform.
The User can associate their email address with their account for password recovery purposes.
The User can access help guides and documentation related to using the platform.
The User can mark a specific recycling facility to easily access it later.
The User can access a dedicated section showing all their saved favorite recycling facilities.
The User can upload their weekly schedule to receive tailored recommendations for recycling centers.
The User can view the rewards they have earned for engaging with the platform's features.
The User can send a text-based message to provide general feedback about the platform.
The User can submit a report detailing an issue encountered at a specific recycling facility.
The User can select a date and time for a recycling pickup service.
The User can specify the categories of recyclable materials they intend to have picked up.
The User can view the generated optimized route or schedule for recycling visits based on their weekly schedule and selected waste types.
The User can receive recommendations for recycling centers that best fit their weekly schedule and waste types.
The Administrator can input all necessary details to register a new recycling facility on the platform.
The Administrator can modify any detail of an already listed recycling facility.
The Administrator can access a dashboard or list of all feedback submitted by users.
The Administrator can assign categories (e.g., bug report, feature request, general inquiry) to user feedback for better organization.
The Administrator can initiate communication with a specific facility representative through the platform.
The Administrator can view messages sent by facility representatives within the platform's communication interface.
The Facility Representative can modify the opening and closing times for their assigned facility.
The Facility Representative can add or remove materials from the list of items accepted by their facility.
The Facility Representative can send a detailed report about an operational issue or concern to the administrators.
The Superuser can modify any data field associated with any recycling facility.
The Superuser can directly reply to questions submitted by users regarding recycling centers.
